study.question: Can relation-conditioned complete-event content and count-dependent feedback shrinkage jointly exceed both frozen source bests in validation four-task macro AUC at justified measured cost? Are the two components useful within the same model?
study.hypothesis: The relation source preserves target-specific complete-event content and ordinal quartiles, but does not explicitly expose task-mask rates or reliability-weighted content-rate products. The shrinkage source preserves those products cheaply, but lacks the 35 relation-temporal token interaction representation. Sharing embeddings and concatenating the compact eight-slot branch with the relation representation may retain complementary signals. This is a compatibility hypothesis, not an established reliability explanation or novelty claim. Overlapping counts/content may instead be redundant.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit its full relation-content token branch, static/global bypasses and joint attention. Append an eight-slot mean-content and historical-task product branch to the four task towers; no change to sequence visibility. Wider first tower layers prevent exact parent initialization equivalence.

Inherit its early uniform eight-way target-category/brand x ordinal-recency compression, 32-dimensional content projection, 8-dimensional task products, explicit counts/raw fractions and n/(n+4) gate toward same-user global rates. Reuse relation-source embeddings and towers instead of a separate model. Omit the source local scorer because it is unused by its uniform forward path. Mask inputs before embedding as in the relation source; exclude positive padding IDs from match evidence. With the released padding zero, grouping matches the shrinkage source; host must confirm metadata.

DIN already uses target-conditioned unnormalized history sums and Dice. Those inherited elements are not new. This proposal combines existing local source representations and tests reliability-conditioned feedback products, not an exact DIN paper reproduction.

Pinned benchmark code pools history with target attention, tokenizes fields and task tokens, and uses heterogeneous interaction blocks and task-token readouts. The inherited relation model instead uses relation/temporal summaries, shared attention/FFN and flattened/raw bypasses; this proposal adds count-conditioned feedback products. No original HiFormer paper reproduction or priority claim is made.

Stacking pooled sequence summaries with feature interaction is established. This study does not claim novelty for that pattern. Full original-method audits of all listed architectures are unavailable; originality remains unverified.

inherited_components: All frozen data/labels/splits/visibility/scoring and host training ownership; no training-loss hook.

Relation source feature embeddings, sanitized masked history and zero target action, unnormalized DIN local activation, global plus four valid-rank quartiles, seven overlapping relation channels, log counts, static fields and raw global bypass, one joint block, four Dice task towers.

Shrinkage source disjoint category/brand match combinations crossed with last 16 supplied positions, uniform mean content, bias-free projections, local feedback fractions from all valid events, global visible-history rates including the local group, strength four.
study.proposed_difference: A parallel compact history branch shares the relation model's embeddings/visible prefix. Its 552 columns (256 compressed content, 8 normalized counts, 256 projected-content x four shrunk-rate products, 32 raw task fractions) join the existing tower inputs. Four standalone arms form a full 2x2 factorial: relation or replicated-global summary content, crossed with count-dependent or fixed-1/2 local/global product interpolation. Relation count channels and raw fractions remain enabled in every arm, so the first factor isolates complete-event content selection and the second isolates occupancy-dependent mixing, not feedback availability. No neural modules are added/removed between arms. This is a late-fusion compatibility implementation; no iterative cross-branch retrieval is claimed.
predictions: Observed starting point, not a new result: DIN macro AUC 0.8099233881, relation-content 0.8275704846, count-shrink 0.8272805337. Relation minus shrink per-task AUC: click +0.0030459073, cart +0.0004270110, fav +0.0005687273, buy -0.0028818420. Macro Logloss is 0.0548851432 versus 0.0548893214. These single imported runs motivate testing complementarity but do not establish it.

Observed slice contrast: relation versus shrink macro AUC is 0.7772994 versus 0.7768388 for history 1-16; 0.8040905 versus 0.8029711 for 17-64; 0.8502787 versus 0.8515904 for >64. Empty-history comparison has only 6444 samples and 13 buy positives and is descriptive/unstable. No occupancy-slice measurements are supplied and none is invented.

Primary predictive success: relation_count exceeds both frozen source macro AUCs under the identical full protocol. Report macro Logloss and each task AUC/Logloss and deltas to DIN and both sources even when some tasks regress. Selection is validation macro AUC only, with frozen tie-breakers; no purchase-only selection or undeclared task veto.

Mechanism support requires relation_count > relation_fixed (count mixing conditional on relation content) and relation_count > replicas_count (relation content conditional on shrinkage). Also report replicas_count - replicas_fixed and relation_fixed - replicas_fixed. The difference-in-differences (relation_count - relation_fixed) - (replicas_count - replicas_fixed) measures interaction; positive interaction is stronger evidence of synergy but is not required for additive complementary utility.

Exploratory localization: retain host history-length bins 0,1-16,17-64,>64 and all per-task samples/positives/negatives. If host permits new diagnostics later, preregister slot occupancy bins empty,1-3,4,5-16,17-100 before scoring; count/fixed local weights coincide exactly at n=4. Raw fractions persist, so rate benefits may be recoverable by tower learning.

Measured cost must accompany quality: full run/train/inference seconds, batch latency p50/p95, peak memory, total/embedding/dense parameters. Do not infer equal compute from equal parameter count. The replica arm omits the relation-content bmm, so runtime can differ. Current source costs: relation 381.2918s total/342.5667s train/29.2285s inference/32,944,773 parameters; shrink 286.9586s/252.9271s/24.2932s/32,288,965 parameters. Static proposed total 33,231,749, dense 1,438,533, embeddings 31,793,216, to be confirmed on host.
falsifiers: The combined relation_count arm fails to exceed the stronger source in validation macro AUC: no demonstrated joint predictive improvement for this implementation, even if purchase alone improves.

Count-dependent mixing is no better than fixed mixing under matched capacity, or relation content is no better than replica content conditional on shrinkage: the corresponding mechanism lacks controlled local support. If only fixed-fusion arms improve, attribute gains to shared branch information/capacity rather than occupancy-dependent reliability.
The apparent gain disappears or changes direction in paired repetitions or clustered uncertainty intervals: retain preliminary/seed-sensitive status; no significance claim from one run.

Nonfinite outputs/gradients, wrong output identity/shape, sensitivity to masked payloads or current target action, any forbidden-information path, or exceeded cost limits invalidates that execution; an execution failure is not scientific evidence against the mechanism.

An improvement costing more may still be a quality-cost tradeoff; it cannot establish efficiency without measured quality-cost frontier or a separately authorized matched-compute contrast. No hardcoded quality threshold is introduced.
alternative_explanations: Additional compact content, raw feedback fractions, finer recent/older grouping or increased tower capacity may explain gains over the sources. The full factorial controls capacity for its two factors, but does not separately ablate every new branch column. A later branch replacement/removal control is needed for total branch attribution.

Source architectures differ in several ways, and sources are frozen bests selected in their own trajectories. Their raw difference is neither a causal mechanism comparison nor an unbiased estimate of best-model advantage. Only these three imported observations are authorized; no failed/abandoned-trial outcomes or seed repetitions are supplied. Parent IDs in receipts are provenance, not extra local evidence.

Uniform means and unnormalized relation sums have different scale/count information, and global shrinkage background includes local observations. Count-dependent mixing is a deterministic feature transform, not measured statistical uncertainty or an independent empirical-Bayes prior.

Shared embeddings, wider towers and a new scratch initialization can alter optimization. Equal new-arm construction controls initialization order between the four arms, but cannot match parent initializations after layer-width changes.

Auxiliary labels are future 24h user/category/brand matches, not advertisement-specific conversions. Category/brand routing may exploit benchmark label construction; official offline delayed feedback and whole-window vocab/static snapshots limit causal/production interpretation.

Field equality may reflect encoded OOV or missing-value collisions; excluding zero/padding does not prove entity identity. Last-16-position and valid-rank-quartile recency are different ordinal partitions, not elapsed time.

If the combination is null, next falsifiable question: do duplicated compact content/raw fractions explain interference, or does earlier token-level insertion improve compatibility at matched capacity? Do not treat one late-fusion failure as refuting all combinations.

cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Initial four full-protocol cells estimated 4x483.4166=1933.6664s, worst capped 4834.1656s, plus charged host safety diagnostics. Keep at least 8000s for discriminating replacement/component controls, any justified fix/retry and closest-reference comparisons; unused time does not require further search.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve 12000s for host-authorized validation-only paired repetitions and full reporting. Target three paired seeds for selected candidate and both frozen source configs plus closest factorial controls when feasible; existing seed counts only with matching protocol/source/config. Host controls repetition seeds, never architecture CONFIG. Freeze source/config/checkpoint identities, suite and commands before any final phase. Test/closed assessment outputs are unavailable and must not be requested or used. All repetitions and diagnostics count.
cost_plan.stop_rule: No training/installations in this proposal environment. Host must first gate forward/backward shapes/finiteness and nonzero finite gradients, BF16 attention, output four [B,1] probabilities, empty/no-match/full/holey histories, cloned-state train and eval invariance to masked IDs/actions/task masks and current target action, visible feedback sensitivity, expected group order/padding, shared-state arm agreement when all events match and rates agree, and host parameter counts. Mask-helper standard-library checks are not these gates. Stop on host hard deadline, trial cap, information/ownership breach or insufficient live budget after reserves. Preserve every error/failed diagnostic cost; unknown execution state never authorizes a duplicate. Do not increase limits. No fresh raw-data digest verification is possible here; trust only the frozen host identity and require host digest/loader gates before execution.
